text:
Nina: Friendly reminder: fantasy playoff tiebreaker is total goals this weekend. Whos locked in?
Ethan: Locked. my bench is pure chaos but the forwards are cooking.
Ravi: Im in for the pot, also bringing mini trophies for the top 3.
Claire: Mini trophies? love that energy. do they come with tiny ribbons?
Nina: Yes! plus the infamous foam crown for the weekly overachiever.
Ethan: Quick poll: should we make next week's prize a pizza or sandwich party? :pizza: or :sandwich:
Ravi: :pizza: all the way.
Claire: :sandwich: my heart belongs to hoagies.
Nina: ops note: kitchen availability Friday 12-1.
OpsBot: Event created: "Fantasy Playoffs Tiebreaker Celebration" Friday 12:00-13:00. Organizer: Nina.
Ethan: Also, anyone streaming the West final tonight? Ill mirror it if you want to join.
Claire: Ill swing by and bring sparkling water.
Ravi: count me in for setup.
Nina: Great. stakes are tacos for the winner if total goals > 3.
Ethan: Deal. I will embarrassingly celebrate if it hits.
OpsBot: Reminder posted in calendar for Friday event.
Claire: tiny trophies + tacos = best office morale combo.
Ravi: See you all Friday. Good luck and may the worst bench decisions be forgiven.
